jobs.name: cartoon-dinner
jobs.prompt:
1990s American animated sitcom, flat cel-shaded 2D cartoon, bold black outlines, saturated primary colors, slightly grainy broadcast look. An original cartoon family at a chaotic dinner table in a cozy suburban dining room: a lanky redheaded dad with round glasses and a mustard cardigan, a mom with a short teal bob and green dress, a freckled kid with wild orange curls. A towering lime gelatin mold sits center table, wobbling ominously.

Timeline:
[0s-1.5s] Mom proudly sets down the giant wobbling gelatin mold, it jiggles in exaggerated squash-and-stretch.
[1.5s-3s] Dad reaches in with a fork, eyes gleaming; the kid flicks a single pea across the table.
[3s-5.2s] The pea hits the mold, the gelatin gulps the dad's fork whole with a comic ripple, the family freezes in a classic sitcom take, dad's glasses slide down his nose.

Static sitcom camera, one slow slight push-in, cartoon physics, exaggerated expressions.

Audio: bouncy 90s sitcom brass-and-clarinet underscore, cartoon boing on each jiggle, a wet gulp at 3.5s, canned studio-audience laughter swelling at 4s, dad groans 'aw, not the good fork!'

jobs.name: superworld-console
jobs.prompt:
35mm photograph of an alternate-1960s broadcast control console in a dark studio. Amber tube glow, brushed aluminum panels with visible weld marks, TEMPERATURE and CONSTRAINT knobs with vernier scales in units nobody can identify. 35mm film grain, documentary photography style.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] Darkness, then a single tube warms to amber, revealing the console's edge.
[2s-4s] Slow push-in as more tubes ignite in sequence down the panel, needles twitching on the meters.
[4s-5.2s] The full console glows, one meter needle pins hard right and holds.

Slow deliberate camera push-in, dust motes drifting in warm light, no cuts.

Audio: low electrical hum rising in pitch, faint tape hiss, a soft relay click at 2s, a deep resonant thunk at 4.5s.

jobs.name: superworld-title
jobs.prompt:
Medium format photograph of an alternate-1960s broadcast monitor on a workbench, screen filling most of the frame. Amber phosphor glow, brushed aluminum bezel, film grain. Text reads SUPERWORLD! in bold broadcast lettering on the screen.

Timeline:
[0s-1.5s] The screen is static snow, the bezel barely lit.
[1.5s-3.5s] The text SUPERWORLD! resolves out of the snow, sharp and legible, glowing amber.
[3.5s-5.2s] The letters begin to dissolve as you watch, edges eating themselves back into static.

Locked-off camera, no push-in, the only motion is on the screen.

Audio: television static, a carrier tone locking in at 1.5s, the tone detuning and sliding away in the last second.
